general_information.name: I THINK YOU MEAN THE NAME ON MY DOCUMENTS? I USUALLY JUST GO BY DANIEL, BUT I’M NOT SURE IF YOU WANT THE FULL VERSION. WOULD YOU LIKE ME TO GIVE THE EXACT LEGAL NAME?
general_information.address: It’s in Toronto, on Sherbourne Street — I’m blanking on the full thing at the moment. Could you ask it a different way?

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly contamination worries and a lot of checking. I keep washing my hands and checking the stove and locks too much — it takes up a few hours a day.
current_concerns.goals: I’m hoping to cut down the checking and the hand washing, and get to work on time more reliably.
